title: The Entrance Hall To The Guild Of Swordsmen
description: The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen.  A place where one has to be careful not to say something wrong (or right).  To the east is the bar and to the north is the main street.
npcs: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.
An oozing green gelatinous blob is here, sucking in bits of debris.
A knight is guarding the entrance.
